fields.claim_quote: Note that this polynomial is $\Pi$-$O(n)$-sparse, and that when expanded, each coefficient in the polynomial is bounded from above by $nt$.
fields.explanation: The source explicitly allows a multiset, so six distinct occurrences of1 are permitted. Mathlib Polynomial.coeff_one_add_X_pow proves that the original coefficient at target2 is choose(6,2)=15>nt12.
fields.flaw: Every coefficient of A(x)=∏ᵢ(1+x^{aᵢ}) is at most nt.
fields.problem: Title: Subset Sum in Near-Linear Pseudopolynomial Time and Polynomial Space
fields.witness: Take n=6, A={1,1,1,1,1,1}, and t=2. All a_i and t are positive integers. Then P(x)=(1+x)^6, so c_2=C(6,2)=15, while nt=6·2=12. Thus c_2>nt, even at j=t.
